Plants and trees

A 4 acre nursery of trees, shrubs and perennials, hedging and saplings, with fruit trees from apples and pears to raspberry canes. Open to the public and trade.

See trees and prices →

Landscaping supplies

Railway sleepers, TimberLok fasteners, decking, pavers, turf and grass seed, fencing, stakes and edging, plus topsoil, compost and wood chip mulch.

See timber prices →

Landscaping

Private commissions with advice on landscape design and horticulture, and public spaces: digging and re-sculpting the landscape, stonework, metalwork and woodworking.

See the work →

Grounds maintenance

Grass cutting, hedge trimming and weed control, large landscaping projects and emergency call outs, for sites from a small office to large public areas.

See where we work →
Tree work as well.Tree surgery and pruning to BS3998, fully insured, with a free visit and friendly advice. Covering Matlock, Bakewell, Chesterfield, Wirksworth, Derby, Nottingham, Mansfield, Belper, Ripley, Ashbourne and more.
